[[Guardsman Zui]] guards the gate to [[Minister Cho's Estate (outpost)|Minister Cho's Estate]], and will inform the player character what it needs to do to gain entry.

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Sunqua Vale}}

==Dialogue==
;Before [[Choose Your Secondary Profession (Factions quest)|Choose Your Secondary Profession]]:
:''"I cannot let just anyone into the Minister's Estate! <character name> should complete more training at the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. Start by speaking to the headmasters. What else do you want?"''

;Before [[A Formal Introduction]]:
:''"Normally, [[Master Togo]] brings his top students to meet the minister. I am sorry, but I cannot let you through without him here. [Character Name] should speak with Master Togo in [[Linnok Courtyard]], that should take care of it. Was there something else you wanted to discuss?"''

;During A Formal Introduction, Togo not present:
:''"I do not see Master Togo anywhere. No Togo, no entry. Was there something else you wanted to discuss?"''

;During A Formal Introduction, Togo present:
:''"What is it? The Minister is very busy and does not see anyone without an appointment."''

;After A Formal Introduction:
:''"Are you going in or not? We really need all the help we can get in there. Well? What are you waiting for?"''

==Trivia==
*Nicknamed "Ol' Zui" by [[Guard Tsukaro]].
